# CLI11 dependency

Unmodified generated single header from CLI11 **v2.7.2**, BSD-3-Clause.

- Upstream: https://github.com/CLIUtils/CLI11
- Release: https://github.com/CLIUtils/CLI11/releases/tag/v2.7.2
- Header: https://github.com/CLIUtils/CLI11/releases/download/v2.7.2/CLI11.hpp
- Header SHA256: `ffa9a30da295c5858fb5f91f9f45771bab09471d7010a34c7c68c857a330dd76`
- `LICENSE` was taken from the same tag; its terms are also embedded in the header.

This dependency belongs to the CLI only, not the capture library DLL. No package
manager or network access is needed to compile the vendored header.
